spec.report:
Verified all 175 file hashes, manifest SHA 5d4e465b5e7f728231d914bf2af4b74ea9a341636bfaca4f452e985b83229330, and patch SHA 450361443d1e4ca9475b2421d5c3150d9bab7045312ba59c8cc8874a3dc69034.

No additional blocker in the previously reviewed mechanics, frozen experiment contract, or final reporting. No scope creep found. Attribution and own-source copying are implemented; architecture and documentation describe their limits accurately. Repair coverage remains partial:

Reopening recognition: requirements say, “Accept affirmative user reopening of the same confirmed task, including varied word order.” fiction-17 supplies “Reopen PF-66 for a staging kiosk trial.” The existing PF-66 identity is recognized, but this positive command never reaches consolidation. Similar to/because forms also fail. The report discloses this limitation; the broad requirement is not fully met.

Constraint retrieval: requirements say, “Preserve useful constraints, obligations and reasons.” In regenerated fiction-05, the merged open_work retains “do not open a second ticket,” but all six candidate contexts omit it; baseline contexts q1–q4 include it. Exact stored evidence therefore does not ensure preservation for the reader. This is a demonstrated retrieval loss, separate from false stored merging.

Completion: requirements include “Human document review” and “Local commit.” At this reviewed snapshot, report review remains open and no new commit exists. These are pending completion steps, not reasons to retune released holdout data.

The report correctly states 32/96 → 33/96, six missing answers per arm, failed quality/recall thresholds, and incomplete pilot status. It preserves the disputed critical grade while distinguishing missed continuity from demonstrated false joining. The ledger independently totals 168 completed calls and 3,041,973 tokens; prior spend, cumulative totals, repeats, superseded attempts, and unknown monetary/engineering overhead are disclosed.

Clearance is for the implementation mechanics and faithful negative-result evidence—not successful pilot quality or complete repair coverage.

root_disposition.spec: Keep both partial requirements visible. Do not tune code to released holdout data or erase the negative result. This commit records a bounded repair and measured failure to meet the pilot gate, not complete semantic quality.
